semantics.closed: Established closure theorem, backed by an operation result and cached Boolean true.
semantics.not_closed: Established counterexample, backed by an operation result and cached Boolean false.
semantics.open: An active source explicitly leaves the closure question open.
semantics.not_assessed: No source-backed closure determination has yet been promoted; this does not assert that the problem is mathematically open.
semantics.not_applicable: The operation has no canonical meaning at this class scope.
